title: A large singleton Fourier coefficient from level-one weight
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, where $n>0$, and let $0\le\delta\le 1/1600$. If the total Fourier weight at level one of the real-valued version of $f$ equals $1-\delta$, then some coordinate $i$ satisfies $1-3202\delta\le \widehat f(\{i\})^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The level-one Fourier weight of $f$ equals $1-\delta$
